The Truth Is Hidden in Plain Sight
For nearly three decades, I’ve obsessed over the news and how it’s delivered, and I’ve noticed a little problem: 
Most of the people delivering it are incentivized to lie to you.
In the media, the rewards favor clicks, outrage, and narratives that are either completely biased or exist solely to confirm what you already want to believe. It’s a feedback loop of noise driven by a system that profits from being wrong.
But there is a corner of the world where people are forced to be honest.
Prediction markets.
If you’ve listened to me with Glenn Beck or watched my shows on BlazeTV, you might know me as the resident data nerd—the guy who spent the last 28 years studying election data and debunking media narratives. But I haven’t just been watching these stories to entertain myself; I’ve been trading them for well over a decade.
I love prediction markets because they force you to put your money where your mouth is. They distill the truth unlike anything else—and the truth can be profitable.
Subscribe for free to receive regular prediction market insights from Stu.
Introducing: Predictable
Predictable with Stu Burguiere
 is a new show and media project built around prediction markets.
Launching in March, we’re moving beyond the punditry to cover politics, culture, and sports by 
finding the edge in the numbers
—with a relentless focus on the upcoming elections. We’re going to use every tool at our disposal to understand the world and anticipate what’s coming next—then, we’re going to turn that knowledge into 
actionable insights that actually move the needle for you.
Politicians have been profiting off us for decades. It’s time we return the favor.
